headline: OpenAI expands Trusted Access for Cyber with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber.

items.title: Scaling Trusted Access for Cyber with GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber
items.summary: OpenAI has rolled out GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.5-Cyber models, extending its Trusted Access for Cyber initiative. These models are designed to improve the efficacy of cybersecurity efforts by enabling verified users to streamline vulnerability research and bolster the defense of critical infrastructure. The addition of these models supports enhanced real-time analysis and threat detection capabilities, crucial for protecting sensitive systems.
items.why_it_matters: These models provide AI developers with powerful tools for cybersecurity, potentially reducing response time to threats.

items.title: Parloa builds service agents customers want to talk to
items.summary: Parloa is utilizing OpenAI models to develop scalable, voice-driven AI customer service agents. The platform allows enterprises to design, simulate, and deploy interactions that are reliable and occur in real-time, enhancing customer engagement.

items.title: Advancing voice intelligence with new models in the API
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced new real-time voice models within its API, capable of reasoning, translating, and transcribing speech. These models aim to deliver more natural and intelligent voice interactions.

items.title: Secure short-term GPU capacity for ML workloads with EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML and SageMaker
items.summary: Amazon has introduced EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML and SageMaker training plans, offering a solution to secure reserved GPU capacity for short-term machine learning workloads. This addresses the challenge of GPU availability during peak demand periods.

items.title: Introducing Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Payments
items.summary: Amazon, in collaboration with Coinbase and Stripe, has launched AgentCore Payments, a new feature in Amazon Bedrock that allows AI agents to instantly manage and pay for resources they consume.

items.title: Testing ads in ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI has begun testing ads in ChatGPT. This move is intended to support the platform's free access model. The ads will be clearly labeled, ensuring answer independence and maintaining strong privacy protections with user control.

items.title: MedQA: Fine-Tuning a Clinical AI on AMD ROCm — No CUDA Required
items.summary: This study explores fine-tuning a medical question-answering AI model using AMD's ROCm platform, highlighting an alternative to the traditional CUDA framework. This approach could open doors for more diverse hardware utilization in AI training.

items.title: LCM: Lossless Context Management
items.summary: A new paper introduces LCM, a deterministic architecture that enhances long-context tasks by outperforming existing models like Claude Code. This architecture is benchmarked on Opus 4.6, achieving superior performance.
